items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: we made the recording on Victor of 'My Old Flame' with Ivie Anderson.

ctx.x: About 1930, I imagine, was the year. That's when I met Duke Ellington, because I worked with Check and Double Check, picture out there within -- yeah, then after that, he came back out here and did a picture with Mae West called 'My Old Flame,' I believe, and he needed a saxophone player then, so he called me up and I made the picture with them and we made the recording on Victor of 'My Old Flame' with Ivie Anderson. I worked a lot of the surrounding jobs around town here in this area before they went back East.…
